# ESP32-S3 refresh A/B at 240 MHz, three sessions on the board ending 3D:C8: every image

rind's time for each image, in µs: the median over that image's flashes, with the number of flashes (n) and the spread (slowest − fastest flash) / fastest. A ratio is the image's median over the control's (`ctl`); below 1 is faster than the control. `ctl` was flashed 18 times; `zero` was flashed 3 times; `rot` was flashed 3 times; `notag` was flashed 3 times; `poly` was flashed 3 times; `all` was flashed 3 times. An image flashed once has one run, so its spread is 0 and says nothing about repeatability; read it against the control's spread. The RustCrypto column is the median of every flash of every image (the same RustCrypto code in each image, a layout control). Every number here is recomputed from [ab-three-sessions.json](ab-three-sessions.json) by `cargo verify`.
All sessions pooled: same board, same images (by sha256), same order. `s1-N` is flash N of [8a5977adb9c32ea2ed010c400f5ffbdcdec14b47-refresh-ab-240mhz-2026-11-22](../8a5977adb9c32ea2ed010c400f5ffbdcdec14b47-refresh-ab-240mhz-2026-11-22/NOTES.md), `s2-N` is flash N of [8a5977adb9c32ea2ed010c400f5ffbdcdec14b47-refresh-ab-240mhz-pass2-2026-11-23](../8a5977adb9c32ea2ed010c400f5ffbdcdec14b47-refresh-ab-240mhz-pass2-2026-11-23/NOTES.md), and `s3-N` flash N of this tree. A flash is still one run.
